epics.title: System Containerization and Deployment
epics.jtbd: When running the product locally, I want to start the full stack with a single command, so that I can verify its real-world behavior and observability.
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file that starts the full stack and exposes a health-check endpoint for local observability

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml for full stack local deployment
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to define the services and health checks, so that the product can be launched and verified for real without manual environment setup
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root
When running docker-compose up
Then the full stack starts successfully and the health-check endpoint returns healthy
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local setup time from manual hours to under 2 minutes

epics.title: Epidemiological Material Cataloging and Management
epics.jtbd: When I manage the epidemiology knowledge base, I want to catalog and update materials, so that the information is structured and up to date.
requirements: R1: Provide UI to update and delete existing epidemiological materials, invoking corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoints

slices.title: Implement update and delete UI for epidemiological materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete actions for this epic, I want to add edit and delete capabilities to the existing material views, so that the catalog can be accurately maintained
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the system
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint and the catalog is updated accordingly
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce outdated material count by enabling immediate deletion and updates

epics.title: Authentication and Authorization Mechanism
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials and prompt them to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication guard for catalog access
slices.jtbd: When implementing the authentication guard for this epic, I want to intercept unauthenticated requests, so that restricted data is protected
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked and prompted to log in
Given an authenticated user
When they access the catalog
Then they are permitted
slices.sixSigmaMetric: achieve 100% block rate for unauthenticated protected route access
